name: git
description: Puts a project's git into a known-good state before the first prompt of every session, for any git repository. On launch it fetches every branch and tag from the remote and prunes stale branch and tag refs, so remote-tracking refs are aligned with the remote before the agent starts. It also simulates GitHub feature-branch protection: a PreToolUse hook blocks any git push that would update main or master directly on the remote, telling the agent to push a non-main/master branch (same local branch name recommended) and open a pull request. A SessionStart hook additionally injects a standing instruction that the git repository (its objects and content) and its forge resources are the Single Source of Truth and win over any conflicting session context, that commits are the work diary, and that a commit carrying a key decision must capture the rationale in its message. The fetch runs synchronously at SessionStart before the agent starts, does nothing outside a git repo, never fails a session, and turns off when GIT_PLUGIN_DISABLE is non-empty. The latest launch status (fetch/prune result and any warnings) is kept per session under the OS temp dir and reported on demand by the read-only launch-status skill.
